title: File - Financings
description: JSON file schema defining a list of financings. Each object represents a financing round, identified by name, date, and associated issuance IDs. Used to group and reference multiple issuances under a single financing event.

issuance_ids.description: Array of issuance IDs associated with the financing

date.description: Date on which the financing event occurred
date.title: Type - Date

comments.description: Unstructured text comments related to and stored for the object

file_type.description: File type field (used to select proper schema for validation)
file_type.title: Enum - OCF File Type
